findings.issue: `primeSpectrumQuotientHomeomorphConnectedComponent` (and its feeder `range_comap_quotientMk_connectedComponentIdeal`, line 129) prove nothing about connected components or idempotents: the argument is the general `Spec (R ⧸ I) ≃ₜ (zeroLocus I : Set (PrimeSpectrum R))` for an arbitrary ideal, here instantiated and carrying an unused `[LocallyConnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum R)]` hypothesis inherited from the section variable.

summary: The bialgebra/finite-type over-assumptions from the prior round are gone; the specialization is now at the augmentation + LocallyConnectedSpace level, which is right.
